lesson_intent.one_sentence_goal: Practice limited past perfect for explaining what had already happened before a plan changed.
lesson_intent.real_life_context: Two colleagues discuss why a simple plan could not happen as expected.
lesson_intent.communicative_function: Explaining background context in a short story.

dialogue_task.scenario: Anna and Erik planned to do something, but a booking, forgotten item, or earlier decision affected the plan.

main_focus.name: past perfect for background
main_focus.description: Use hade plus supine sparingly to show that something happened before another past event.
main_focus.desired_presence: Use past perfect naturally 2 times in the dialogue.

vocabulary_target.desired_presence: Keep the past perfect examples practical and limited.

dialogue_shape.opening: One person asks why a plan changed or became complicated.
dialogue_shape.middle: A background event is explained with hade plus supine and followed by the main past event.
dialogue_shape.ending: They explain how the situation was resolved.

target_complexity.repetition: two clear past perfect examples are enough

focus: what background event happened before the main event
how that background event changed the plan

sentence_focus: one sentence explaining why a plan changed
one sentence with the main event in preterite
one sentence saying that the problem was solved
